data.name: Holiday Inn Express Piedras Negras by IHG
data.address: Esq. De, Ave. Lazaro Cardenas : 2500, Santa Cruz Y Calle Arroyo, 26060 Piedras Negras, Coah., Mexico
data.description:
Occupying a bright, modern building close to the USA/Mexico border, this low-key hotel is 4 km from the Museo De La Frontera Norte and 8 km from Piedras Negras International Airport.
The casual rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, coffeemakers and desks. Cribs are available. Room service is available. Kids age 12 and under stay and eat at no cost with an adult.
Freebies include a continental breakfast buffet and parking, as well as airport shuttle service. Other amenities include an indoor pool, a fitness room, a 24/7 business center and coin-operated laundry facilities.
